question: I report!! I'm the person called "Yaypott Papy" whose name was printed in the Usopp Gallery Pirates' Section in Volume 19. Thanks to you it's a manga to learn from, and generally speaking, I managed to make my debut as a mangaka. Takahashi
answer: Oh. Seems you came back. Since I've been doing this for 18 years now, I'm also glad to see my readers grow up! This means that the first book of "The Mystery of the Dinosaur (Kyouryuu No Fushigi)" was published. Those of you who want to know about dinosaurs, absolutely!! Please choose the book of your friend.
name: Takuma Takahashi
